Proposed diagram changes
  |-- Mapping page - MCP and HTTP API  existing canvas
      |-- [1a] Modify Mapping page: exposed interfaces at 03f2168
      |   |-- Replace the obsolete twelve-tool and per-mutation exec summaries: include saved AgentContexts, repository and DiffTree discovery, CanvasViews, diagram contexts, create/extend/batch editing, compact canvas.read, and batched-by-default exec with receipts and version guards; retain immediate mode.
      |   |-- Distinguish live browser access, isolated ChangeSession proposals, and managed-generation child canvases. Show AgentChat's bound, turn-scoped tools and its chat/generation HTTP operations without treating children as browser documents.
      |   `-- Extend the route summary for DiffSession workflows, push integrations, review and presentation operations, while retaining existing workspace, catalog, selection, chat, and compaction interfaces.
      |-- [1a] Modify Mapping backend: grouped responsibilities (03f2168)
      |   |-- Replace the claim that every exec mutation has its own checkpoint: buffered mutations commit together at read or completion boundaries; immediate mode retains per-call commits. Show compact reads, opaque read-scoped handles, idempotent receipts, and expected-version checks.
      |   |-- Add AgentChatService as owner of persisted chats, turns, captured references, turn-bound tool access, direct supplied-edit batches, cancellation, and generation children. ChatDiagramTools calls AgentDiagrammingSessionService and its atomic DiagramBatchService; FileChatStore persists chat sessions.
      |   |-- Add GenerationCanvasBridge under AgentChatService: each child owns an isolated headless controller, history, receipts, and persistence callback. Parent CanvasView capture and result synchronization still dispatch through the live browser bridge; link to the existing Saved CanvasViews and branching diagram.
      |   |-- Add AgentContextLibrary for durable saved contexts, alongside the existing scoped upload service; add DiffSessionWorkflowService for pinned-hunk proposal workflows and PushIntegrationService for repository push intake. Their detailed responsibilities remain with their existing owners.
      |   `-- Keep ChangeSession review and atomic publication, diagram revision/review/presentation operations, workspace record persistence, and explicit catalog saving as distinct responsibilities. Do not imply backend authority over live browser state has been consolidated.
      |-- [2] Add: AgentChat turns and supplied diagram edits
      |   |-- Attach from the new AgentChatService component in the modified backend diagram; its caller is AgentChat HTTP/MCP transport and its owned state is chats, turns, bindings, references, and generation requests.
      |   `-- Detail scope: agentChatService.ts:1-590; chatDiagramTools.ts:1-269; agentChat.ts:1-144; diagramBatchService.ts:1-111; chatBindings.ts:1-22; chatStore.ts:1-25. Reuse the existing supplied-edit diagram rather than duplicating its revision pipeline.
      `-- [2] Add: Managed CanvasView alternative generation
          |-- Attach from the new GenerationCanvasBridge component under AgentChatService; AgentChatService calls it, and it owns isolated child controllers, histories, receipts, and persistence callbacks.
          `-- Detail scope: agentChatService.ts:143-323; generationCanvasBridge.ts:1-94; canvasGeneration.ts:1-26; canvasHistory.ts:292-374. Connect to the existing Saved CanvasViews and branching diagram; do not require a node from another unpublished proposal.
